follow-up time: From birth to 12 years of age
cohort: 1,505 individuals (aged 0-12 years) in a mother-infant cohort and in a child cohort
finding: Measles antibody evolution is strongly predictive from birth at the individual level, including following vaccination.
mod_finding: Caesarean section births were linked with a 2.56-fold increased odds of primary vaccine failure, highlighting the long-term immunological consequences of birth route.
